title: Flood Fill
contract: Recolor the four-connected component containing (sr,sc) from its original color to color; return the modified rectangular image.
signature: int[][] solve(int[][] image,int sr,int sc,int color)
brute: int old=image[sr][sc];boolean[][] reached=new boolean[image.length][image[0].length];reached[sr][sc]=true;boolean changed=true;while(changed){changed=false;for(int r=0;r<image.length;r++)for(int c=0;c<image[0].length;c++)if(reached[r][c])for(int[] d:DIRS){int nr=r+d[0],nc=c+d[1];if(nr>=0&&nr<image.length&&nc>=0&&nc<image[0].length&&!reached[nr][nc]&&image[nr][nc]==old){reached[nr][nc]=true;changed=true;}}emit("Repeat full scans until reachability stops changing","reached",reached);}for(int r=0;r<image.length;r++)for(int c=0;c<image[0].length;c++)if(reached[r][c])image[r][c]=color;return image;
optimal: int old=image[sr][sc];if(old==color)return image;Deque<int[]> q=new ArrayDeque<>();q.add(new int[]{sr,sc});image[sr][sc]=color;while(!q.isEmpty()){int[] cell=q.remove();for(int[] d:DIRS){int r=cell[0]+d[0],c=cell[1]+d[1];if(r>=0&&r<image.length&&c>=0&&c<image[0].length&&image[r][c]==old){image[r][c]=color;q.add(new int[]{r,c});}}emit("Recolor on discovery to mark visited","cell",cell,"image",image);}return image;
reasoning: Repeated relaxation discovers all cells reachable through the old color but may scan the grid many times.
A queue processes each newly discovered cell once, using the new color as its visited mark.
Return immediately if the new color equals the old one; otherwise recoloring would not distinguish visited cells and could cause repeated traversal.
